messages:
nina: quick heads-up: customer reported weird negative token adjustment after a streaming session with a mid-request toolcall that got truncated and retried. gist attached.
omar: negative adjustment? paste logs please.
nina: minimal logs:
```
2026-04-10T11:12:33.000Z [stream] session=aaa event=provisional tokens=200 tx=t1
2026-04-10T11:12:33.100Z [toolcall] session=aaa call=kb_lookup event=provisional tokens=120 tx=t2
2026-04-10T11:12:33.350Z client=EOF -> server truncates response; client retries with smaller max_tokens
2026-04-10T11:12:33.500Z [toolcall] session=aaa call=kb_lookup event=provisional tokens=40 tx=t3
2026-04-10T11:12:33.700Z [ledger] confirm tx=t1 tokens=200
2026-04-10T11:12:33.720Z [ledger] confirm tx=t2 tokens=120
2026-04-10T11:12:33.800Z [ledger] adjust tx=t3 tokens=-120 // ledger reconciled overlap badly
```
nina: ledger applied a negative adjust referencing tx3 which ended up being a retry; net effect the customer saw -120 then +120 in the console out-of-order so daily totals looked wrong.
zack: interesting. sounds like ledger reconciler treats retried provisional as replacement and emits a compensating adjustment referencing older tx id. but ordering made UI show transient negative.
kevin: two problems: attribution between stream vs toolcall prefixes is fuzzy, and our ledger reconciliation doesn't emit causal metadata for reconciliation events (commit id / canonical tx).
console-bot: billing-alert created: unusual-adjustment session=aaa delta=-120
omar: immediate mitigation: change reconciler to emit reconciled_confirm with fields: canonical_tx, replaced_tx, net_tokens. That way UI can display "reconciled: t2 replaced by t3, net 0" rather than a raw negative adjust.
zack: agreed. also internal API change: when services send confirm RPC they should include original_provisional_range and final_confirm_range, so ledger can compute overlap deterministically rather than heuristically.
kevin: UX: console timeline should group provisional -> confirm -> reconcile as a single line item, and show toolcall as a nested child under the stream. current flat list is confusing.
omar: telemetry: add metric reconciliations.per_minute and reconciliation-negative-deltas to detect bad ordering. also tag reconciliations with source-service (router|toolcall-worker) and request-trace.
nina: short-term PR: make reconciler emit reconciled_confirm events (no negative raw events), and buffer confirm events for 200ms to allow retries to surface and avoid transient negative lines. tradeoff: small delay in confirm visibility.
zack: buffer idea ok for console, but ledger durability must still be correct. the buffer should only affect emitted UI events not ledger state.
kevin: long-term: canonicalization of provisional ids at request boundary. when a toolcall retry happens, it should reference prior provisional id as "retry_of" so reconciler has clear lineage.
console-bot: created ticket: CONSOLE-857 timeline-reconcile-view
billing-bot: created ticket: BILL-492 reconciler-event-metadata
omar: plan: 1) quick reconciler change to emit reconciled_confirm (nina) 2) console timeline patch to render reconcilations as single line (kevin + console) 3) API change PR to add original_range metadata for confirms (zack) 4) telemetry alert for negative-delta spikes (omar)
nina: thanks all. I'll attach the repro harness to the ticket and run a small canary with buffered UI events only. ping me if you want to pair on the ledger metadata schema.
